commands.install_python: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install reportlab flask flask-cors
commands.run_cli_tex_prototype: python3 nuts_calc_tex.py <paper_size> <command> [options]  # requires pdflatex; experimental, not wired into web/backend or factory.sh

notes.package_manager: No requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/setup.py exists for the Python side (a prior setup.py was removed per commit d9fc0a3, verified: 'git log -- nuts_calc.py'). README.md's Setup/Dependencies sections describe installing Flask/Flask-Cors/reportlab manually via pip, and web/frontend has its own package.json/package-lock.json for npm.

notes.tests: tests/ contains 15 Python test files (pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, pythonpath=.). Collected 222 tests on 2026-08-06. tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py has 9 known stale failures and 13 passes; fraction/backend unit tests (22) and fraction pdflatex CLI tests (2) pass. A complete run excluding test_nuts_calc_init.py did not return a final summary in the observed execution environment and remains unconfirmed.
notes.known_defects: None currently known. The previously-tracked web/frontend build failure (missing i18next dependencies) is resolved: package.json lists i18next/react-i18next/i18next-browser-languagedetector/i18next-http-backend, and 'npm install && npm run build' was re-verified to succeed on this branch (2026-08-05). See docs/L3_implementation/specification_summary.md. Separately, tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py has 9 known-stale failing tests (see notes.tests above) that are not a defect in nuts_calc.py itself.
notes.nuts_calc_tex_py: Experimental LaTeX renderer with zero code sharing with nuts_calc.py. It implements the seven ReportLab-compatible commands plus the LaTeX-only frac command (issue #65). Requires pdflatex and vendors longdivision under vendor/texmf/. web/backend/renderers.py selects it with NUTS_CALC_RENDERER=latex; the frontend hides frac cards for reportlab.
